title: Carry forward MVP safety invariants as runtime gates
purpose: Convert completed MVP safety constraints into entry and exit gates for Agent Core Runtime implementation.
scope: List all invariants from the completed MVP final audit.
Map invariants to tests that must keep passing during AgentCore changes.
Define new runtime-specific gates for model output, memory writes, observation processing, and approval pauses.
Define regression commands required before each wave completion.
Record that shell.exec remains denied in normal mode.
acceptance_criteria: New runtime tasks cannot be completed if they bypass semantic tools, policy, audit, or rollback.
Secret, memory, and observation-specific risks have explicit regression fixtures.
Release readiness requires both old MVP safety gates and new AgentCore gates.
verification: Run cargo test -p agentd before runtime implementation starts.
Inspect safety fixture list for prompt injection, tool abuse, resource abuse, secret handle, rollback, observation injection, and memory poisoning.
Confirm future task acceptance criteria reference the gate checklist.
risk_notes: Adding AgentCore increases autonomy pressure; the completed MVP constraints must become stronger, not optional.
